messages.subject: Two questions
parts:
Hi ggplotters.

When I plot time series charts (say monthly) the labels are usually for the following month (eg when I plot data trough Dec 2012, the label for December data point is jan 2013). Is there anyway to make the date scale move by end of period instead of beginning of next?

Also is there a way to move the x axis label to the top instead? I would like to use this in the context of geom_tile where the cells show values like in a spreadsheet table.

Thanks a lot.


Cheers, Anil
